purpose: Run the independently hammered M479 lane-local RTL at the exact M477 3 ns pre-macro constraints and decide only whether its intended enable distribution closes all design-rule constraints.

identity_guard.invalid_prior_reason: The prior command reused a Tcl script with a hard-coded M476r2 top; its m476r2 netlist identity makes every numerical result inadmissible for M479.

pass_gate: Elaborated and mapped design identity is exactly the required M479 top.
Setup and hold path slack are nonnegative.
The max-delay, min-delay, max-capacitance, max-transition, and max-fanout reports are all clean.
Mapped hierarchy and references retain auditable M479 lane-local structure.
An independent receipt-blind hammer confirms all extracted values and the identity guard.
failure_rule: Any wrong top, design-rule violation, negative timing slack, missing report, or identity ambiguity is NO-GO. Do not relax constraints or cite partial values.
